# Welcoming Alex Noakes to Infinite


We are excited to announce that Alex Noakes has joined Infinite as our Founding Member of Technical Staff, helping to shape and lead our platform engineering efforts.


By[Nikhil Srinivasan](https://infinite.net/company/about) , Founder & CEO


·


July 16, 2026


·


1 min read


Team


We’re thrilled to welcome Alex Noakes as as our Founding Member of Technical Staff, helping to shape and lead our product engineering efforts.


Alex is an industry leader at the intersection of traditional and blockchain financial services and product engineering, and brings a rare blend of practitioner depth and product leadership.


At Infinite, our platform is an embedded layer across our customers' products. Alex expertise reinforces that layer and accelerates our mission to build the best stablecoin experience for global commerce.


Excited to have you on board, Alex!
